intentAndPurpose.intent: Composite page navigator with backward-compatible numbered `truncate` and selectable `compact` treatments. Compact composes the existing Select menu, displays `current / total`, and supports previous/next plus optional first/last controls. Uncontrolled by default (`defaultPage`); pass `page` + `onPageChange` for controlled mode. Includes a WAI-ARIA navigation landmark, keyboard support, selected-option semantics, and a polite live region.

props.name: totalPage
props.description: Total number of pages. Required. Values < 1 render an empty navigation landmark.

props.name: appearance
props.description: Multi-accent appearance role for page chips and nav controls. `'auto'` inherits the nearest Surface role. At the page root, numbered selection navigation, and the compact Select trigger fall back to primary.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible label for the navigation landmark. Default `"Pagination"`.

props.name: attention
props.description: Emphasis level for the **selected** page chip only — `high` (bold fill), `medium` (tinted fill), `low` (ghost). Inactive page chips stay ghost with high-emphasis numeral colour; nav + ellipsis stay ghost + low attention. Default `'medium'` for `truncate`; Figma's `compact` treatment defaults to `'high'` when this prop is omitted.

props.name: boundaryCount
props.description: Number of always-visible page numbers at the very start AND the very end of the sequence. Default `1`. Set to `0` to hide them. Only used when `type="truncate"`.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional class name applied to the root.

props.name: defaultPage
props.description: Default current page (1-based) when uncontrolled. Default `1`.

props.name: firstLast
props.description: Show the first-page / last-page jump buttons. Default `false`.

props.name: fullwidth
props.description: Stretch to fill the container width per Figma `fullwidth`. Default `false`.

props.name: onPageChange
props.description: Fires whenever the active page changes (click, keyboard, controlled update).

props.name: prevNext
props.description: Show the previous-page / next-page arrow buttons. Default `true`.

props.name: siblingCounts
props.description: Number of always-visible page numbers immediately around the current page. Default `1`. Only used when `type="truncate"`.

props.name: size
props.description: T-shirt size for page chips, nav `IconButton`s, and ellipsis. Default `'M'`.

props.name: type
props.description: Pagination layout. `truncate` renders windowed page numbers + ellipses; `compact` renders prev/next around a Select showing `current / total`. Default `'truncate'`.

interactionBehavior.summary: Pagination is a composite navigator, not a set of independent buttons: in `type="truncate"` (the default) only the current numbered page is in the tab order, and `ArrowLeft` / `ArrowRight` change the page — they do not merely move focus. Prev/next/first/last stay separately tabbable and ignore those arrows. `type="compact"` drops the numbered chips for a Select of `current / total` plus the same nav IconButtons.
hover: Numbered chips own their hover in PaginationItem — see that component. Pagination's layout CSS has no hover rules.
Prev / next / first / last are IconButtons at `attention="low"`, so they take IconButton's ghost hover fill (and IconButton's `(hover: hover)` guard).
Ellipsis is a permanently `disabled` IconButton inside an `aria-hidden` span, so it never hovers.
press: Numbered chips scale UP on press and delay `onSelect` until that transform transition settles — documented on PaginationItem.
Nav IconButtons use IconButton press (scale UP, ghost pressed fill). They fire `setPage` immediately on click; they do not wait for a transition.
Compact's page chooser is a Select `selectableButton` trigger; its press is Button's, including Button's scale-DOWN squash.
focus: Truncate: only the current numbered page has `tabIndex={0}`; other page chips are `tabIndex={-1}` and are reached by arrows, not Tab. Tab from the current page moves to the next nav IconButton (or out of the control).
Each numbered chip paints PaginationItem's two-layer halo; each nav IconButton paints IconButton's.
A polite, visually hidden live region announces `Page N of M` after every change.
keyboard: On a numbered page chip (`data-type="page"`): `ArrowRight` / `ArrowDown` step to the next page and move focus there; `ArrowLeft` / `ArrowUp` step back. This CHANGES the selected page, it does not rove focus across the visible chips.
`Home` jumps to page 1; `End` jumps to the last page. Both also move focus to the new current chip after the windowed slot list reshuffles.
Arrows on a prev/next/first/last IconButton do nothing — those stay individually focusable and activate with `Enter` / `Space` like any IconButton. Tests cover this.
If the control is `disabled` or `totalPage` is 0, the key handler returns immediately.

Compact does not use this roving handler. Keyboard behaviour is Select's (closed typeahead when `totalPage` is 99 or fewer; Search when `totalPage` > 99) plus ordinary IconButton keys on the nav pair. While a large compact menu is closed, only the current page is registered as an option — the full list materialises on open.
selected: The current page chip is `aria-current="page"` with `data-selected="true"`. Its fill follows Pagination `attention`: `--{Role}-Bold` at high, `--{Role}-Subtle` at medium, transparent plus a `--{Role}-Bold` hairline at low.
Unselected chips stay ghost with `--Neutral-High` numerals (surface-auto appearance, not the Pagination `appearance` role).
Compact shows the selection as the Select trigger label `N / total`; opening the menu and picking a page calls `setPage` and closes.
disabled: `disabled` on the root sets `[data-disabled]`, `--Disabled-Opacity` (via `--Pagination-disabledOpacity`), and `pointer-events: none` on the whole `<nav>`. Clicks and arrows no-op.
Prev is natively disabled on page 1 and next on the last page, even when the control is enabled.
Ellipsis IconButtons are always `disabled` and `aria-hidden` — they are decoration, not a jump-to control.

Because the root has `pointer-events: none` while disabled, `cursor: not-allowed` on inner natively-disabled chips is not observable. This is the known system-wide gap (docs/design/disabled-states.md).
touch: Chip hover fills are `(hover: hover)`-guarded on PaginationItem; a tap's response is the press scale-up plus the delayed page change.
Nav IconButtons follow IconButton touch rules (no hover fill, press scale-up still runs).
